subject: CS481
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 videos. For English, all topics were well-covered with highly relevant and popular videos. For Arabic, strong candidates were found for XSS, SQL Injection, and DDoS. The 'Trojans, Ransomware, and Rootkits' topic had a suitable academic lecture that met the view count exception. No eligible Arabic video could be found for 'Ethical Analysis of Firesheep'.

coverage.note: Selected the best available video on XSS as no candidates covered Drive-By Downloads.
No eligible candidates found. The only shortlisted video was irrelevant and failed the view count gate.
No candidate met the 3000-view threshold; selected the best option above 500 views.

Cyber Attacks: DoS, DDoS, and IoT
coverage.note: Selected a strong video on DDoS as no eligible candidates specifically linked it to IoT.

videos.title: Every Cyber Attack Type Explained in 5 minutes
videos.topic_ar: البرمجيات الخبيثة على الويب (XSS والتنزيل التلقائي)
videos.filter_reason: This is a clear, well-produced overview that explicitly covers both XSS and Drive-By Downloads with timestamps, making it highly relevant to the compound topic.

videos.title: Running an SQL Injection Attack - Computerphile
videos.topic_ar: التصيد الاحتيالي وحقن قواعد البيانات SQL
videos.filter_reason: This classic Computerphile video is an authoritative and exceptionally clear deep-dive into how SQL injection attacks work, making it perfect for a university-level audience.

videos.title: HTTP Cookie Hijacking in the Wild: Security and Privacy Implications
videos.filter_reason: This Black Hat conference talk discusses the security and privacy implications of cookie hijacking, directly referencing Firesheep's impact, which provides the necessary context for an ethical analysis.

videos.title: Every Type of Computer Virus Explained in 8 Minutes
videos.topic_ar: أحصنة طروادة، برمجيات الفدية، والجذور الخفية
videos.filter_reason: With over 2 million views, this animated explainer effectively breaks down all three malware types (Trojans, Ransomware, and Rootkits) in a concise and memorable format.

videos.title: What is the Mirai Botnet, How to Prevent DDoS Attacks?
videos.topic_en: Cyber Attacks: DoS, DDoS, and IoT
videos.topic_ar: الهجمات السيبرانية: DoS و DDoS وإنترنت الأشياء
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a perfect explanation of the topic by using the famous Mirai botnet to illustrate how compromised IoT devices are used to launch massive DDoS attacks.

videos.title: سؤال في امن المعلومات: سرقة بيانات المستخدمين
videos.topic_ar: البرمجيات الخبيثة على الويب (XSS والتنزيل التلقائي)
videos.filter_reason: An excellent and focused explanation of how Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) is used to steal user data, which is the most critical part of the topic.

videos.title: SQL Injection شرح لحقنة السيكول
videos.topic_ar: التصيد الاحتيالي وحقن قواعد البيانات SQL
videos.filter_reason: This is a highly-viewed and exceptionally clear animated explanation of SQL Injection, making a complex topic very accessible for students.

videos.title: أمن المعلومات/ البرمجيات الخبيثة ( Malware ) / الجزء 3 والأخير
videos.topic_ar: أحصنة طروادة، برمجيات الفدية، والجذور الخفية
videos.filter_reason: This academic lecture covers Ransomware and Rootkits in detail, and was the best available option as no other candidates passed the view count gate.
